# Pick My Resolution: full page text

> Complete text of pickmyresolution.com: every page, plus the full bank inside its free quiz.
> The quiz picks one New Year's resolution you can keep. Four questions, about one minute.
> Free forever. No ads, no accounts. Your answers stay in your browser.
> Text captured from the live site, 2026-10-27.

### The four questions

1. Pick one part of your life. Options: Body and health; Money; Home; Work; Family and friends; Mind and calm.
2. What was hard this year? Options: I felt drained a lot. Things piled up on me. I felt stuck in place. I drifted from good habits. I felt alone a lot.
3. How much time do you have each week? Options: 30 minutes a week; 2 hours a week; 5 hours a week.
4. What made past plans fail? Options: I tried to do too much. I just forgot to do it. Life got busy and loud. I got bored and quit.

### The bank: 30 actions, 90 resolutions

Each action below appears at three time levels, so the bank returns one of 90 resolutions.
Every result also carries a first move for week one, one note for when it gets hard (picked by question 4),
a weekly check-in prompt to copy into your own AI, and a year card with 52 dots, one for each week.

#### Body and health

- Take a short walk (when you felt: I felt drained a lot.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Take a short walk: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Take a short walk for 10 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Take a short walk: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Take a short walk for 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Take a short walk: 30 min, 7x a week." First move: Take a short walk for 30 min.
- Cook a real meal (when you felt: Things piled up on me.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Cook a real meal: 30 min, 1x a week." First move: Cook one real meal. Give it about 30 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Cook a real meal: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Cook one real meal. Give it about 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Cook a real meal: 60 min, 5x a week." First move: Cook one real meal. Give it about 60 min.
- Do a short workout (when you felt: I felt stuck in place.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Do a short workout: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Do a short workout for 10 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Do a short workout: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Do a short workout for 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Do a short workout: 40 min, 5x a week." First move: Do a short workout for 40 min.
- Stretch your whole body (when you felt: I drifted from good habits.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Stretch your whole body: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Stretch your whole body for 10 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Stretch your whole body: 20 min, 5x a week." First move: Stretch your whole body for 20 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Stretch your whole body: 20 min, 7x a week." First move: Stretch your whole body for 20 min.
- Walk with a friend (when you felt: I felt alone a lot.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Walk with a friend: 30 min, 1x a week." First move: Walk with a friend for 30 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Walk with a friend: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Walk with a friend for 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Walk with a friend: 45 min, 5x a week." First move: Walk with a friend for 45 min.

#### Money

- Check your bank balance (when you felt: I felt drained a lot.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Check your bank balance: 2 min, 3x a week." First move: Check your bank balance now. It takes about 2 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Check your bank balance: 5 min, 3x a week." First move: Check your bank balance now. It takes about 2 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Check your bank balance: 5 min, 5x a week." First move: Check your bank balance now. It takes about 2 min.
- Sort bills in one spot (when you felt: Things piled up on me.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Sort bills in one spot: 20 min, 1x a week." First move: Sort bills in one spot for 20 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Sort bills in one spot: 30 min, 1x a week." First move: Sort bills in one spot for 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Sort bills in one spot: 30 min, 2x a week." First move: Sort bills in one spot for 30 min.
- Move cash to savings (when you felt: I felt stuck in place.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Move cash to savings: 2 min, 1x a week." First move: Move one small amount to savings today.
  - 2 hours a week: "Move cash to savings: 2 min, 2x a week." First move: Move one small amount to savings today.
  - 5 hours a week: "Move cash to savings: 2 min, 3x a week." First move: Move one small amount to savings today.
- Write down what you spend (when you felt: I drifted from good habits.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Write down what you spend: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Write down what you spend for 10 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Write down what you spend: 10 min, 5x a week." First move: Write down what you spend for 10 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Write down what you spend: 10 min, 7x a week." First move: Write down what you spend for 10 min.
- Tell a friend your goal (when you felt: I felt alone a lot.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Tell a friend your goal: 15 min, 2x a week." First move: Tell a friend your goal for 15 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Tell a friend your goal: 30 min, 2x a week." First move: Tell a friend your goal for 30 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Tell a friend your goal: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Tell a friend your goal for 30 min.

  - 2 hours a week: "Have a friend visit: 60 min, 2x a week." First move: Have a friend visit. No timer. Just talk and relax.
  - 5 hours a week: "Have a friend visit: 60 min, 3x a week." First move: Have a friend visit. No timer. Just talk and relax.

#### Work

  - 5 hours a week: "Plan your day on paper: 10 min, 7x a week." First move: Plan your day on paper for 10 min.

  - 2 hours a week: "Clear your desk top: 15 min, 4x a week." First move: Clear your desk top for 15 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Clear your desk top: 20 min, 5x a week." First move: Clear your desk top for 20 min.

  - 2 hours a week: "Play one game together: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Play one quick game together.

- Call a friend you miss (when you felt: I drifted from good habits.)
  - 30 minutes a week: "Call a friend you miss: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Call a friend you miss. Talk as long as feels good.
  - 2 hours a week: "Call a friend you miss: 30 min, 4x a week." First move: Call a friend you miss. Talk as long as feels good.
  - 5 hours a week: "Call a friend you miss: 30 min, 5x a week." First move: Call a friend you miss. Talk as long as feels good.
- Visit someone you love (when you felt: I felt alone a lot.)

  - 2 hours a week: "Visit someone you love: 60 min, 2x a week." First move: Visit someone you love. Take your time and stay a while.
  - 5 hours a week: "Visit someone you love: 60 min, 4x a week." First move: Visit someone you love. Take your time and stay a while.

#### Mind and calm

  - 30 minutes a week: "Sit in a quiet place: 10 min, 3x a week." First move: Sit in a quiet place for 10 min.
  - 2 hours a week: "Sit in a quiet place: 20 min, 5x a week." First move: Sit in a quiet place for 20 min.
  - 5 hours a week: "Sit in a quiet place: 20 min, 7x a week." First move: Sit in a quiet place for 20 min.

  - 5 hours a week: "Read a calm book: 60 min, 5x a week." First move: Read a calm book for 60 min.

  - 5 hours a week: "Sit outside with others: 30 min, 5x a week." First move: Sit outside with others for 30 min.

### The four notes for when it gets hard

- I tried to do too much. -> Keep this one small. Small still counts.
- I just forgot to do it. -> Put your move on your calendar today.
- Life got busy and loud. -> Miss a day? Do half the next day.
- I got bored and quit. -> Change the place or time each week.

### The weekly check-in prompt (template)

The prompt copies with your own resolution and first move filled in. Shape, shown with the first bank entry:

Weekly check-in for my resolution.
Resolution:
Take a short walk: 10 min, 3x a week.
First move:
Take a short walk for 10 min.
Did I do my move this week?
What got in my way?
What is one small move for next week?
Please keep your reply short and kind.

## Privacy (https://pickmyresolution.com/privacy)

Privacy - Pick My Resolution
Pick My Resolution
Privacy
Your quiz plan stays in your browser.
Cloudflare and PostHog count visits to this site.
There is no account or email signup.
What the quiz saves
Finishing the quiz saves your four answers and result.
The result includes its check-in and share text.
The save uses this browser's local storage.
Your answers and plan stay on this device.
Anyone using this browser can open it.
The quiz code uses local storage, not cookies.
The result screen also offers a letter card.
Writing a note saves that note too.
It saves the open date you picked.
Your note is never sent to us.
Clearing your saved plan
Open your saved plan and tap Start over.
That button removes the saved answers and result.
It removes your saved note too.
Browser site-data controls can remove it too.
Copying and sharing
Copy buttons place text on your clipboard.
The site does not send copied text anywhere.
You choose where to paste copied text.
Sharing starts only when you tap Share.
Site counts
This page loads Cloudflare Web Analytics.
It sends page and performance counts to Cloudflare.
Cloudflare says its beacon uses no cookies.
Cloudflare says its beacon does not read local storage.
The home page also runs PostHog.
PostHog counts page views and quiz starts.
It counts finishes, shares, and return visits.
It counts check-in copies, year cards, and letter cards.
Your note text is never sent to it.
Your quiz answers are never sent to it.
It does not record your screen.
Contact
Questions about privacy: hello@pickmyresolution.com.
Changes
Changes appear on this page.
Built with Muse.

## Terms (https://pickmyresolution.com/terms)

Terms - Pick My Resolution
Pick My Resolution
Terms
The short version: This site gives one free plan.
What this site is
These terms cover this website only.
Pick My Resolution picks one resolution.
You answer four short questions.
The quiz picks one move for you.
Your plan fits the time you pick.
It is free forever.
There are no ads on this site.
There is no account or email signup.
Your plan
Your plan shows one resolution.
It shows a first move for week one.
It shows help if it gets hard.
It includes a weekly check-in prompt.
It includes share text you can copy.
You can make a year card picture.
Ideas, not advice
Plans here are general habit ideas only.
They are not medical advice.
They are not mental-health advice.
They are not financial advice.
Use your own judgment with any plan.
Your saved plan
The quiz runs in your browser.
Finishing the quiz saves your four answers.
It also saves the result you see.
Your answers and plan stay on this device.
Cloudflare and PostHog count visits here.
PostHog counts quiz starts, finishes, and shares.
See the Privacy page for full details.
No guarantees
This site is provided as is.
We give no warranty.
We cannot guarantee any habit outcome.
We are not liable for any loss.
The site may have errors or downtime.
Fair use
Do not try to break this site.
Do not copy the whole action bank.
Do not claim our words as yours.
We may change or stop this site.
Contact
Questions about terms: hello@pickmyresolution.com.
Changes
Changes will appear on this page.
